newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Robinson's outlines plan for new project.
newsitem.headline: Robinson's outlines plan for new project.

text.p: Robinson's Land Corp outlined on Friday its plan to build a commercial and business complex on its 37-hectare North Triangle property in Quezon city.
It has earlier reported signing a lease agreement with the National Housing Authority (NHA) for the 37-hectare property.
In a statement, RLC said it plans to build a shopping centre, hotel, park and mixed-used buildings in the area. It did not disclose how much the project would cost.
It added the area it will lease is the largest tract of prime land remaining in the area. It is strategically located near the 26-hectare depot of the proposed Light Railway Transit.
It will have a 50 percent stake in the project, with New San Jose Builders as its partner.
The lease with NHA will run for 50 years, the statement said.
